adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB write happens first via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)`, then `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` is called without a surrounding try/catch or transaction. If the calendar update throws, the mutation will error back to the client while the attendee rows have already been committed. On retry with the same emails, `uniqueGuests` becomes empty because it filters out already-persisted attendees, triggering `BAD_REQUEST` (`emails_must_be_unique_valid`), leaving the external calendar potentially unsynced. This cascading failure mode is directly implied by the diff.
